All 14 queries ran against the input files. I checked the outputs by hand for P2, P5, P8 and P14. The others I judged from their output only.

- **P10:** the line `DB_NAME=main # not a comment, part of value?` keeps its whole value, `#` part included, as the task says.
- **P11:** the three users tie at 50, so the order comes from the user tiebreak.

P1: filter ~(/active | eq true) * (at :address | coalesce {} | at :country) | filter ~(ne null) | groupBy * count
P2: filter ~(/status | lower | :s / | ["paid" "shipped"] | contains s) * (at :items | coalesce [] * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2
P3: filter ~(at :dependencies | coalesce {} | count | gt 2) * /name | sort
P4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") * (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login | coalesce "unassigned") | groupBy * count
P5: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 * /number
P6: /data/items | filter ~(/price | ne null) | groupBy ~/category * (* /price | avg | round 2)
P7: lines | filter ~(split " " | at 1 | lower | eq "error") * (split " " | filter ~(startsWith "user=") | first) | filter ~(ne null) * (drop 5 | lower) | distinct | sort
P8: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") * split "," | filter ~(/2 | ne "") * {:dept /1 :sal (/2 | parseJson) :name /0 :start /3} | groupBy ~/dept * (* /sal | avg | round 1)
P9: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") * split "," | filter ~(/2 | ne "") * {:dept /1 :sal (/2 | parseJson) :name /0 :yr (/3 | take 4 | parseJson)} | filter ~(/yr | gte 2022) | sort ~(/sal | desc) | take 2 * /name
P10: lines | filter ~(trim | ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(startsWith "DB_") * (split "=" | [(/0 | drop 3 | lower | keyword) (drop 1 | join "=")]) | tag ::map
P11: filter ~(/type | lower | eq "purchase") | filter ~(at :payload | coalesce {} | at :amount | ne null) | groupBy ~/user * (* /payload/amount | sum | round 2) | entries * {:user (/0 | keyword) :total /1} | sort ~([(/total | desc) /user])
P12: ["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","cherry","Elder","fig","FIG","apple"] * lower | groupBy * count | entries | filter ~(/1 | gte 2) | sort ~([(/1 | desc) /0]) * ([(/0 | keyword) (/1 | print)] | join ":") | join ","
P13: "1.10.2, 1.2.10, 1.9.0, 0.99.99, 1.10.10, 1.10.9" | split ", " | sort ~(split "." * parseJson) | last
P14: filter ~(:r / | (r | at :stock | coalesce {} | at :main | coalesce 0) | add (r | at :stock | coalesce {} | at :backup | coalesce 0) | lt 10) * /sku | sort | reverse
